unresolved: White 2022 numeric calibrated occupation bounds deferred: reviewed abstract supplies climatic periods only.
Graf 2017 chapter metadata and Fladmark/Borden/Mandryk details not independently reviewed; no detailed facts inferred from synopsis.
Aqil continuity cannot be formally tested with one new ancestor; Lindo/Cui relationships do not prove original coastal route or uninterrupted demographic stasis.
Steffen 2024 resource gaps and Praetorius 2023 favorable modelling windows use different proxies and subregions; retained as limits, not falsely harmonized.
Mason social drivers are review interpretations; Alix’s two-house sequence is local, not a launch date for all Inuit movements.
corrections: Sea-ice windows24.5–22ka and 16.4–14.8ka belong to Praetorius 2023, not Steffen 2024.
Steffen does not prove continuous Alexander Archipelago refugia across glacial maxima; finds gaps and explicit physical/resource constraints.
Aqil TYYS median2950calBP has2500–3379calBP2σ reservoir-adjusted range; one genome does not prove3000years uninterrupted continuity.
Twenty-five ancient Prince Rupert exomes are not the sample size of Cui 2013: it generated four ancient and three living mitogenomes.
Pacheco2022 is wolf genetics, not cosmogenic deglaciation dating; water vole and beluga entries also excluded from human migration claims.
Alix dates local transition laterthirteenthcentury with Thule-house occupation into earlyfourteenth, not initiation of all eastward Inuit migrations.
Tremayne805components and1180radiocarbon dates are not individuals; caribou crash is tentative mechanism, coastal ASTt persistence retained.
Anderson online2018/issue2020 distinguishes revised coastal chronology from proof of climate causation.
No join of disjoint Praetoriuswindows or conversion of open-ended thresholds into invented occupied spans.
